caption: This advertisement is split into two sections. On the left, a soccer player in a light blue jersey and black shorts is captured mid-kick against a blurred background of a crowded stadium. The right side features a bright blue background with the "citi" logo at the top right. Large white text reads "Celebrate the game with Coca-Cola." Below this, a graphic of a soccer ball sits above promotional text offering fuel savings and exclusive gifts at Esso. A white outlined box details the April and May promotions, showing images of a Coca-Cola 4-slim-can pack and contour glasses. Three Citibank credit cards are displayed below the box, alongside the text "To apply for your Citibank Card, visit www.citibank.com.sg". The bottom right corner contains logos for Coca-Cola, Cheers, FairPrice Xpress, and Esso. Fine print lines the bottom edge.

The image shows the lower half of a person’s bare legs and feet against a pale green background. The person is wearing glossy red open-toe platform shoes. Wrapped around both lower legs is a large, stiff paper Burger King crown, featuring the yellow and blue logo and a sunburst pattern. In the bottom right corner, text reads "check our new chicken salads" in multicolored letters above a photograph of a salad containing grilled chicken, tomatoes, and white cheese. Below the salad, a white decorative swirl pattern is visible.

This promotional infographic for Dunkin' Donuts presents a "Flavor Radio!" campaign using sound recognition technology to release coffee aroma. The layout features the Dunkin' Donuts logo, a white atomizer device, and a speaker emitting a sound wave toward it. A central storyboard illustrates a bus scenario where a radio jingle triggers the machine to release coffee scent, leading people to a shop. Below, a large coffee cup sits among coffee beans next to a collage of small photographs showing buses, commuters, and storefronts. Text sections labeled "Background & Mission," "Idea," and "Result" detail the campaign's strategy and outcomes, including a bar chart showing a 16% increase in visitors and a 29% increase in sales.

This advertisement features a vibrant red background with a large, detailed image of a salad in a clear bowl on the right side. The salad contains mixed greens, sliced grilled chicken, corn, black beans, and a lime wedge. To the left, a small figure of a person with a backpack is shown running along a winding path. Above the runner, yellow text reads "A Taste That Inspires," followed by three checked boxes labeled "New Trail," "New Gear," and "New Salad." Black decorative silhouettes, including a bird and floral shapes, frame the salad bowl. Faint background graphics include a compass, a rose, and activity icons. The McDonald's logo and the text "The New Southwest Salad. i'm lovin' it" appear in the bottom right corner.

This image features three blue Pepsi cans arranged against a solid, dark blue background. The central can is positioned slightly forward, flanked by the other two cans slightly behind it to the left and right. Each can displays the classic red, white, and blue circular Pepsi logo and the word "pepsi" written vertically in white lowercase letters. Dynamic splashes of clear water surround the cans, arcing over the top and wrapping around the sides. Small water droplets are scattered in the air. The cans cast clear reflections on the surface below them. At the bottom center, the text "REFRESH YOUR WORLD pepsi" appears in white.

A clear plastic bottle labeled "ethos WATER" is tilted downward against a plain white background, pouring a stream of light blue water. The water lands and forms the shape of a heart, complete with bubbles and splashes, with a few droplets falling below it. In the top right corner is a green circular logo featuring a siren. At the bottom, black text reads "Your sip, their survival." followed by a paragraph explaining that the Ethos Water Fund helps people thirsty for clean water and that buying a bottle at Starbucks contributes five cents to the fund.

This image features a white background with text on the left and two glass Coca-Cola bottles on the right. The prominent text reads "Share a Coke with a friend," with "Coke" in red, followed by smaller text encouraging viewers to get in touch with friends and a website address. Two hands hold the bottles, tilting them toward each other so they touch at the necks, with liquid splashing upward from the contact point. The bottles are covered in condensation and have red labels displaying the names "Kylie" and "Luke" in white. The Coca-Cola logo and "open happiness" slogan appear in the top right corner.

A print advertisement on a white background features a single cherry tomato and a wedge of pale yellow cheese. The tomato, positioned in the lower left, is bright red with a green stem. To its right stands a tall, triangular wedge of cheese with a textured surface. Text on the left reads, "Dunkin Donuts is now offering a little bit more than just your morning donut. We now offer personal pizzas made just for you whenever you want one." At the bottom, the Dunkin' Donuts logo appears with the tagline "more than coffee and donuts," followed by small print listing participating states.

This image features a central graphic with the yellow McDonald's arches logo behind a red and gray text banner reading "THE HISTORICAL TIMELINE OF THE McDONALD'S MENU IN THE USA." Below the text, a diverse array of food items is arranged horizontally against a white background with faint, vertical text. From left to right, the items include fried chicken pieces, a dessert cup, a long sandwich, a double-patty burger, a breaded chicken sandwich, a bowl of salad, a wrapped flatbread item, and two containers of french fries. No people are visible in the image.

This advertisement features a textured, light yellow background with large, bold red text at the top reading "COME BACK and SHAKE UP YOUR WAKE UP." The Burger King logo is located in the top right corner. In the center, a black, oval-shaped bowl holds a mixture of yellow scrambled eggs, diced potatoes, pieces of sausage, and red and green peppers. To the right of the bowl sits a breakfast muffin sandwich containing a sausage patty, egg, and cheese. Below the bowl, text reads "New BK BREAKFAST BOWL," and below the sandwich, text reads "New BK BREAKFAST MUFFIN SANDWICH." Small print is in the bottom left corner.

This image features a blue background with a large, bold white slogan on the left and a Pepsi can on the right. The text, arranged in three stacked lines, reads "REFRESH," "YOUR," and "WORLD," and is tilted diagonally upwards from left to right. To the right of the text, a dark blue Pepsi can is positioned vertically. The can is covered in numerous water droplets, suggesting condensation. It displays the classic circular red, white, and blue Pepsi logo near the top, with the word "pepsi" written vertically in white lowercase letters below it. The can has a silver rim at the top and bottom.

A white paper coffee cup with a matching white lid sits on a light wooden surface in the left foreground. The cup displays the green circular Starbucks Coffee logo featuring a siren. Along the left edge of the cup, there is a vertical column of small, faint square icons, and small text is printed near the bottom. To the right, large white text reads "The best coffee" above "For the best YOU.", with "YOU." in dark green. Below this, white cursive text says "Taste of Inspiration." with a white underline. The background is a heavily blurred, warm-toned interior with bright light on the right.

This advertisement features a solid red background with white outlined circles floating above a man and a woman. The man on the left has dark hair and wears a grey collared shirt over a white undershirt. The woman on the right has long dark hair and wears a red, white, and blue plaid shirt. Both are smiling broadly and looking down while holding glass bottles of Coca-Cola. The woman’s hands are wrapped around her bottle, and the man holds his near the bottom. In the upper right corner is the white Coca-Cola logo above the text "#openhappiness." Below this, large white text reads "happiness. coca-cola." A QR code and small text are in the bottom right corner.

Centered against a light blue gradient background is a sculpture made of clear glass or water, shaped like a hamburger. The top bun is a rounded, transparent dome filled with water, containing a live orange goldfish. Below it, a middle layer forms a wavy, irregular patty shape, and a smooth, curved bottom layer rests on a surface casting a soft shadow. White text reading "Filet-O-Fish®" appears above the sculpture. In the bottom right corner, a red square displays the yellow McDonald's "M" logo above the white slogan "i'm lovin' it".

This image is a print advertisement set against a solid, light green background. In the upper left corner, white text reads, "MAKES OTHER SNACKS LOOK SCARY." Centered in the image is a snack food shaped like a spider, consisting of two textured, orange-brown spherical pieces forming a body with eight similar appendages extending outward. In the bottom right corner, partially overlapping the green background, is a clear plastic cup filled with a light-colored blended beverage. The cup features a logo with the words "DUNKIN' DONUTS" and "Smoothie." A line of small black text runs along the bottom edge.

Centered in the image is a single, upright Pepsi can against a dark blue background. The can features a vibrant, abstract design in various shades of blue, with the classic red, white, and blue circular Pepsi logo positioned above the brand name in white lettering. Surrounding the can is a dynamic splash of clear water, with droplets and bubbles suspended in mid-air, particularly around the top and right side. A soft, glowing light emanates from behind the can, creating a bright halo effect and casting a subtle reflection on the surface below. At the bottom center, the text "every PEPSI refreshes the world" is written in small, white font.

This image features a large, detailed hamburger centered against a gradient red background. The burger consists of a sesame seed bun, leafy green lettuce, two thick slices of red tomato, a slice of white onion, pickles, melted yellow cheese, bacon, and two beef patties. Above the burger, large white text with a red outline reads "BURRRGERRR KING." In the bottom right corner, there is a small white logo of a figure with outstretched arms above the Burger King logo. Text below the burger reads "AGORA COM SOTAQUE CARIOCA." followed by smaller text indicating a new location.

This image features a dark brown background with a glowing, transparent coffee cup positioned on the left side. The cup is filled with a dark liquid and has a bright, luminous yellow-white light emanating from its surface, with a stream of glowing yellow particles rising upward like sparks or steam. To the right of the cup, large, bold white text reads "BUY ME A COFFEE." In the bottom left corner, there is a circular logo with a green and white siren design, followed by the text "STARBUCKS. REAL COFFEE." in white capital letters.

This advertisement features a bright red background with a large Coca-Cola logo in the upper left corner. In the center, a smiling woman with long dark hair, wearing a white top, holds a large plastic bottle of Coca-Cola. The bottle is covered in condensation droplets, and she grips it with her right hand. To the right of the bottle, the word "perfection" appears in large white letters, with "perfección helada" written below it in smaller text. Further down, the words "ice cold" are displayed in yellow. Cubes of ice are visible along the bottom edge of the image.

The image is a minimalist advertisement set against a plain white background. Dominating the center is a single, diagonal strip of cooked bacon, positioned with the top end pointing towards the upper left and the bottom end towards the lower right. The bacon displays distinct, wavy stripes of reddish-brown meat alternating with lighter beige fat. To the left of the bacon, a block of small, maroon text describes the product. At the bottom center, the Dunkin' Donuts logo appears in orange and pink, accompanied by the tagline "more than coffee and donuts." A line of fine print runs along the very bottom edge.

The image features a solid red background with three clusters of golden-yellow French fries arranged to resemble exploding fireworks. One large fry cluster is positioned on the left, a medium one is on the right, and a smaller one is near the top center. The fries radiate outward from central points. Below the fries, centered white text reads, "CELEBRATING CANNES CREATIVE MARKETER OF THE YEAR." At the bottom, there is a white logo for "Leo Burnett" on the left and the yellow McDonald's "M" logo on the right. No people are visible.

A woman with long, wavy brown hair is featured against a solid light blue background. She wears a blue dress with a sweetheart neckline and red nail polish. She is holding a silver Diet Pepsi can near her face with her right hand, appearing to sip from a red-and-white striped straw. The can has condensation on it. To the right, white text reads "prueba el gran sabor de" above the Diet Pepsi logo and a Splenda logo. In the lower right corner, a separate image of a Diet Pepsi can displays a red lipstick mark. Below the woman, white text says "más sexy que nunca" and "Únete al movimiento. f pebsipr".

This image presents a Starbucks advertising concept titled "COFFEE BRAILLE." On the left, a large white poster features raised Braille dots made of actual coffee beans arranged in lines. Below the beans, brown text reads "NOVOS CARDÁPIOS EM BRAILLE STARBUCKS," and a green Starbucks siren logo sits in the bottom right corner. The right side includes the Starbucks logo, text explaining the campaign's challenge and solution, and three smaller photos. These photos show a close-up of the coffee bean Braille, a man reading the poster on a wall, and a hand touching the coffee bean dots.

A burger sits on a dark, rough-hewn wooden surface against a black background. The burger features a black bun topped with white sesame seeds. Below the top bun are layers of green lettuce, red tomato slices, white onion rings, and a beef patty covered with melted yellow cheese. A piece of white paper rests beneath the bottom bun. To the right of the burger, a bottle labeled "A1" lies on its side with dark sauce visible near the opening. Above the bottle, white text reads "HALLOWEEN WHOPPER," with smaller text below stating "A1 FLAVOR BAKED INTO THE BUN."

Four glass Coca-Cola bottles stand side-by-side against a solid red background. The bottles are covered in condensation and filled with dark liquid. From left to right, the labels are red with white text reading "Coca-Cola since 1886," green with white text reading "Coca-Cola life lower calorie," black with red text reading "Coca-Cola zero calories," and silver with black and red text reading "Diet Coke no calories." To the right of the bottles, large white text reads "Good things come in fours." In the bottom right corner, smaller white text says "choose happiness" next to a small graphic of a bottle outline containing the four label colors.

The image features a solid, deep red background with a central graphic composed of four curved, golden-yellow objects arranged to resemble a standard Wi-Fi symbol. These objects have a textured, slightly speckled surface and appear to be French fries, decreasing in size from the top arch to the smallest bottom piece. In the bottom right corner, there is a small yellow logo consisting of a stylized letter "M" with rounded arches. Directly below this logo, the text "love free wi-fi" is written in small white letters. No people are visible in the image.

This image is a promotional poster with a light yellow background. At the top, the text "YOU CAN'T PUT A PRICE ON" appears in orange, followed by "HAPPINESS" in large, bold pink letters. In the center, a silver-colored coin resembling a US quarter is shown with a large, semi-circular bite taken out of its right side. The coin features a profile portrait and the text "UNITED STATES OF AMERICA" and "LIBERTY." Overlapping the bite mark is a chocolate-frosted donut with rainbow sprinkles. Below the imagery, orange text reads "BUT 25 CENT DONUTS HELP." followed by smaller black text detailing the promotion for October 25th. A small Dunkin' logo is in the bottom right corner.

This image features a large Pepsi paper cup positioned on the left side, set against a background divided into red, white, and blue sections. The cup displays the classic red, white, and blue Pepsi design with the logo printed vertically in white near the bottom. It is covered in water droplets and filled with a dark, iced beverage. Above the cup, a splash of clear liquid arcs upward against the red background. To the right, large white text reads "ENJOY A PEPSI" over the blue section. At the bottom right, smaller text says "LIVE FOR NOW" with a small Pepsi globe logo.

This advertisement for Starbucks Seasonal Blends features a four-panel grid of hot beverages in clear glass mugs with handles. The top left shows a brown drink topped with whipped cream and caramel drizzle, with caramel candies nearby. The top right displays a similar drink with whipped cream and chocolate chips. A central green horizontal band contains the white Starbucks siren logo, flanked by the text "The perfect blend for your favorite show..." and "...and any other occasion." Below this, the bottom left panel shows a drink with a flat white foam top decorated with a caramel lattice pattern. The bottom right features a drink with whipped cream dusted with spice. The words "ADVERTISEMENT" appear in the bottom right corner.

A vertical stack of four cartoonish cow figurines stands on a smooth, light-colored surface against a plain, pale green background. The cows are white with black spots, peach-colored muzzles, and small horns. Each wears a red bandana around its neck. They are balanced on top of one another, with the bottom cow standing on its hind legs and supporting the next cow above it. The top cow has one front leg raised. A soft shadow and reflection appear on the surface below them. In the lower right foreground, a small circular Burger King logo and the words "BK STICKER" rest on the surface.
